description: Get the changed files and unified diff hunks of a pull request. Patches are trimmed to whole hunks within a character budget; lock files and build output are skipped. Every file is listed, and files without a patch have an 'omitted' reason. If 'truncated' is true, call again with 'files' to read specific files in full.

files.description: Only return these file paths. Use this to drill into files that were truncated or omitted in an earlier call.

maxChars.description: Character budget for all patches combined (roughly 4 characters per token)

name: get_pr_diff
title: Get pull request diff
